(
	_shellman_renice_pids=\$(pidof -- "${1:processName}") || exit
	_shellman_renice_status=0
	unset IFS
	# shellcheck disable=SC2086 # pidof output must split into individual PIDs
	for _shellman_renice_pid in \${_shellman_renice_pids}; do
		sudo renice -n ${2|-20,-15,-10,-5,0,5,10,15,19|} -p "\${_shellman_renice_pid}" || _shellman_renice_status=\$?
	done
	exit "\${_shellman_renice_status}"
)
description: change running process priority. n: -20 (highest priority) to 19 (lowest priority)
